text:
Which statement about hydrated cobalt(II) chloride is correct?
A
It turns blue when it is heated.
B
It turns blue when water is added to it.
C
It turns pink when water is added to it.
D
It turns white when it is heated.

options.label: A
options.text: It turns blue when it is heated.

options.label: B
options.text: It turns blue when water is added to it.

options.label: C
options.text: It turns pink when water is added to it.

options.label: D
options.text: It turns white when it is heated.
